Ha!  They will come whether you let them or not!
No thanks, we Franklins have always rolled our own.
Hmmm^\255\003Seeing as I'm not yet the most powerful man on Earth^\255\003^I may need some help later if I have to launch this thing again.
There will be power enough for all, in time.\255\003There aren't any time machines yet, anyway.
Using one of my newest inventions.
I like to call it^\255\003THE FRANK-O-COPTER!
That's a kite, Ben.\255\003They've been around for thousands of years.
Oh, sure^\255\003^as toys.\255\003But this one is a letter to the gods!
It says, `Dear Thor, just one drop of your mighty juice^\255\003^in the hands of a genius like me^\255\003^could illuminate the entire world!
I hope you wrote it in Swedish so Thor can read it.
I was speaking figuratively.\255\003What actually is happening is that I'm waiting for lightning to strike my kite.
Aren't you missing a key or something?
Isn't it too sunny for lightning?
Well, I'm going to back away now, just in case.
The key to discovery is DARING INTELLECT, my boy!\255\003Daring intellect and rigorous science!
No, I mean a real key-key.
You mean, the `Where the heck did I put my keys?` kind of key?
That's a manual device!\255\003It needs no power!\255\003Seriously man, what are you thinking?
Shhh!\255\003I know that.\255\003I'm just trying to keep my grant going until we get a storm.
And then the electricity charges the kite.
Then the electricity travels down the string.
I glow with its almighty power.
I use its power to make the world a better place.
The world kneels before me, asking me to guide it with my mighty benevolence.
I have all annoying pests like you locked up.
You got it^\255\003^just hang on there.
She's too heavy.\255\003I can't control her!
Look at her go!\255\003Now all we need is a little--
Off we go, into the wild blue yonder^
I think we've got it this time^
If you lick it, you'll shock your tongue.
No.\255\003It's right where I want it.
Well, I'M all ready to go.\255\003But I guess I have to wait for Bernard and Laverne.
That's no good.\255\003It needs some real JUICE!
I don't want to get locked out.
He's not as striking in person as he is on the dollar bill.
He looks kind of shifty to me.
They're pretty shaken up already.\255\003I'd better leave them be.
Thank you, this is exactly the sort of thing I need for the time capsule.\255\003I'll bury it tonight, and it won't be seen for hundreds of years.\255\003Future generations are in your debt.
If I had a nickel for every time I've seen that face^
This stuff takes the fun outta graffiti.
I can't.  Vandalism hasn't been invented yet.
The father of our country is gazing out at me.
Hmm.  This door appears to be locked.
I should plug that into the battery and get the heck out of here!
I should plug that into the battery, once it's charged.
I should plug that into the super-battery^\255\003^once I get one made.
I don't think it'll get much power from that.
I wonder what idiot started the fire?
I wonder if they've put the fire out yet?
I hope we can get back to work soon.
I bet this never happens to Tom Paine.
Wasn't Ben Franklin talking about starting some sort of `Fire Department`?
Not now, son, can't you see we're in the middle of a crisis here?
I'm afraid we're a little busy right now.
